Name: A Yorkie Pet Mod
Author: bigsquishy0
Description:
This mod adds a Yorkshire Terrier as a new dog breed in Stardew Valley. It doesn’t change how pets behave. The Yorkie follows all the same animations and behaviors as the standard dog in the game. Nothing fancy!

You can pick the Yorkie as your pet when you start a new save, or adopt it later from Marnie for 40,000g if you’re already mid-game. It doesn’t replace any other pets, it just adds a new one to the list.

﻿That’s really all there is to it. I made this because I wanted to see my dog in the game.

This one’s for you, buddy. Going 10 years strong. 💛

11/7 Edit: We sent you to sleep today. Love you, buddy. We miss you.
